assumptions: Triệu USD và triệu viên. Toy: 5 batches, 2 million tablets each; 8% rejected before release, no salvage. All released tablets sold at $1.5; full manufacturing cost 8 million.

evidence.text: 5 lô sản xuất, mỗi lô 2 triệu viên; 8% tổng sản lượng bị loại QC.
Tất cả viên đạt bán $1,5/viên; chi phí sản xuất 8 triệu USD gồm cả phần loại.
Không inventory đầu/cuối, R&D, distribution hoặc tax.

qas.question: Find gross tablet production.
Find quality-released tablet volume.
Calculate sales revenue from released tablets.
Find manufacturing cost per released tablet.
Why not divide cost by only the cost of successful production?
qas.answer: The stated full cost includes rejected output; unit cost of released product uses that full cost.

qas.question: Does rejection rate identify a specific quality defect?
qas.answer: No. It gives an aggregate rejected share, not the defect cause.

qas.question: Can net profit of the pharmaceutical company be determined?
qas.answer: No. R&D, selling costs and taxes are missing.

qas.question: Can a recall probability be estimated from batch rejection?
qas.answer: No. Release rejection is not post-market recall evidence.

assumptions: Triệu kg và triệu USD. Toy wet grain adjusted to standard 14% moisture preserving dry matter. Input moisture 20%; all adjusted grain saleable. No processing losses.

evidence.text: Khối lượng ướt 10 triệu kg, độ ẩm 20%. Độ ẩm chuẩn 14%.

qas.question: Find dry matter mass.

qas.answer: Water is removed; dry matter stays constant under the toy.

qas.answer: No. Moisture adjustment is a weight conversion, not a quality-rejection count.

qas.question: Can drying energy consumption be computed?

qas.question: Can crop yield per hectare be found?
qas.answer: No. Harvested area is not supplied.

assumptions: Triệu đơn và tỷ VND. Toy courier: 2 million parcels, first attempt success 85%, of failed parcels 80% succeed on one retry; remaining returned. Revenue only successful deliveries. Cost per attempt all attempts.

evidence.text: 2 triệu kiện, giao lần đầu thành công 85%. Kiện fail đều retry một lần, 80% retry thành công.
Cước 25 nghìn VND/kiện giao thành công; chi phí 12 nghìn/attempt.
Fixed costs 8 tỷ, không doanh thu return hoặc khoản khác.

qas.question: Find parcels delivered on first attempt.
Calculate successful retry deliveries.
Find total delivery attempts.
Calculate operating result on supplied charges.
qas.answer: Successful deliveries = 2×85% + 2×15%×80% = 1.94m. Attempts = 2+2×15% = 2.3m. Operating result = 1.94×25−2.3×12−8 = 12.9 billion VND.

qas.question: Why is revenue not charged on every attempt?
qas.answer: The toy charges only successful deliveries, while costs apply to every attempt.

qas.question: Does a successful retry remove the first-attempt cost?
Can delivery time per successful parcel be found?
qas.answer: No. No timestamps or route duration are provided.

qas.question: Can customer satisfaction be inferred from delivery success?

qas.question: Can tower-level capacity constraints be identified?

qas.question: Can maintenance capex for added tenants be estimated?

qas.question: Can teacher expense per student be treated as total education cost per student?

qas.question: Can student-to-teacher ratio be calculated?

qas.question: Find contained metal in stockpile A.

qas.answer: No. Recovery determines extracted metal, not original contained metal.

qas.question: Can margin per tonne ore be calculated?
Can optimal blending be inferred?

qas.question: Can daily peak waiting time be computed?
